![Solitaire Setting | Rare Carat](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09242103-2330-0066-0000-5ec26203db2d:4)
An engagement ring setting is the `metal architecture and mounting technique used to secure the center gemstone and shape the overall look of the ring`.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-styles/)

### Popular Engagement Ring Setting Types

- **Solitaire:** A timeless design featuring a single center stone held by four or six prongs, maximizing light exposure and focus on the diamond.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-styles/)[[3]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)
- **Halo:** A ring of smaller accent stones encircling the center diamond, adding brilliance and making the main stone look larger.[[1]](https://www.sarahojewelry.com/articles/the-complete-guide-to-engagement-ring-styles)
- **Pavé:** Tiny diamonds set closely together along the band using small metal beads, creating a continuous paved surface of sparkle.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)
- **Bezel:** A protective rim of metal that wraps completely around the edge of the stone, offering a sleek, snag-free profile ideal for active lifestyles.[[1]](https://www.gabrielny.com/engagement-rings/all-settings)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-styles/)[[3]](https://friendlydiamonds.com/ring-settings)
- **Three-Stone:** Flanks the main center gemstone with two smaller side stones representing the past, present, and future.[[1]](https://friendlydiamonds.com/ring-settings)[[2]](https://www.sarahojewelry.com/articles/the-complete-guide-to-engagement-ring-styles)
- **Cathedral:** Features graceful arches of metal lifting the center stone higher above the band for an elegant, architectural profile.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DbB5Ym9x-FP/)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)

### Shopping for Settings
Settings without a center stone typically range from around $350 for a simple [Solitaire Solstice Style Setting](https://www.blissdiamond.com/products/solitaire-solstice-style-engagement-ring-setting-14k-white-gold?variant=39808076872&country=US&currency=USD&utm_medium=product_sync&utm_source=google&utm_content=sag_organic&utm_campaign=sag_organic&srsltid=AU7gw4V0f-x8ESG_AIVVW6bc5nOTdpKQEFZkVJ3JXk_9MD3gouMgPG-UA1A) up to several thousand dollars for intricate halo or designer frameworks. You can explore diverse options and modular designs through specialized curators like [Robbins Brothers](https://www.robbinsbrothers.com/shop/engagement-rings/ringswithoutacenterstone) or browse extensive collections at [Kesslers Diamonds](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/engagement-ring-settings/) and [Gabriel & Co.](https://www.gabrielny.com/engagement-rings/all-settings).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:9864332785669019320,catalogid:5430739659325724871,gpcid:15069782145497187039,mid:576462877518299714&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:12447952895184421034,catalogid:13132957156511088915,gpcid:2206780931088173350,mid:576462839612612506&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-styles/)[[4]](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/engagement-ring-settings/)[[5]](https://www.gabrielny.com/engagement-rings/all-settings)[[6]](https://www.robbinsbrothers.com/shop/engagement-rings/ringswithoutacenterstone)If you'd like help narrowing down your choices, tell me:

- What **center stone shape** (round, oval, emerald, etc.) do you prefer?
- Do you have a preferred **metal type** (yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, platinum)?
- What is your **lifestyle or activity level** day-to-day?
